items.source: SemiAnalysis, ClusterMAX 1.0 / How to Rent GPUs
items.text: SemiAnalysis documented the 2024 decline in H100 rental prices as a wave of capacity ordered during the 2023 shortage came online at once. The report introduced the ClusterMAX rating system for GPU cloud providers.

Of 16 gigawatts of US data-centre capacity targeted for 2026, 5 gigawatts had entered active construction, and 30% to 50% of the remaining 11 gigawatts was projected to slip into 2027 or later. Power transformer lead times averaged 128 weeks.
Apollo Academy estimates combined hyperscaler capital expenditure of about $646 billion in 2026, up sharply from 2025, with most of the increase directed at AI data centres and accelerators.

items.source: SemiAnalysis, The Great GPU Shortage: Rental Capacity (H100 one-year rental price index)
items.text: SemiAnalysis launched an H100 one-year rental price index built from monthly surveys of more than 100 market participants. The one-year contract price rose from $1.70 per GPU-hour in October 2025 to $2.35 in March 2026, a rise of almost 40%. The firm reported on-demand capacity sold out across all GPU types and said all capacity coming online until August to September 2026 had already been booked.

TSMC's advanced-packaging (CoWoS) supply-demand gap is reportedly about 20% and is expected to narrow to about 10% by the end of 2026. TSMC capacity could reach 120,000 to 140,000 wafers a month by then, and close to 200,000 including outsourced partners.

Broadcom's AI semiconductor revenue was $16.7 billion in its fiscal third quarter of 2026, up 221% year on year, with custom accelerators (XPUs) making up 73% of it. Broadcom guided to about $115 billion of AI semiconductor revenue for fiscal 2027 and named Google, OpenAI and Meta among its custom-chip customers.

items.source: Sascha Steffen, Nvidia's $500bn AI financing platform (credit analysis)
items.text: A credit analysis of Nvidia's lending and guarantee arrangements across AI infrastructure borrowers. Nvidia acts as supplier, equity investor and backstop at once: it holds about $2 billion of CoreWeave equity and has committed a $6.3 billion backstop to purchase CoreWeave capacity that goes unsold.
Closing share price on September 30, 2026: $228.38. Shares outstanding about 24.1 billion, implying an approximate market capitalisation of about $5.5 trillion.

TrendForce projects the average selling price of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) will rise 121% in 2027 as shortages persist. Micron has contracted the bulk of its 2027 HBM supply. Second-quarter 2026 HBM revenue share was SK Hynix 50%, Samsung 33% and Micron 18% (Counterpoint).

For the quarter ended July 26, 2026, NVIDIA reported data-centre revenue of $89.0 billion, up 117% from a year earlier, and a gross margin of 75.0%. It guided to total revenue of $108.0 billion for the next quarter. The company said its next-generation Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production.

items.source: NVIDIA pre-announcement reported by a news wire (SYNTHETIC)
items.text: NVIDIA pre-announced that data-centre revenue for its fiscal third quarter of 2027 (quarter ending late October 2026) will exceed $104 billion, more than double the year-earlier quarter, with gross margin above 76%. It attributed the result to earlier-than-planned shipments of its Vera Rubin platform.

items.source: Company press release via news wire (SYNTHETIC)
items.text: NVIDIA announced the dates and venue for GTC Europe 2027, which will be held in Paris in June 2027 alongside a developer training programme.
